title: Clocktower Horologist
premise: A long timing drama in the city clocktower. Technician Hanshuang and apprentice Doudou guard the astronomical escapement wheel; Doudou and Aheng look nearly alike but wear different neckwear; the brass inspection cradle crashes and must be avoided; the timing log, count memory, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.

states.prime_horologist: A forty-year-old clocktower technician in a gray felt newsboy cap and gray felt work clothes, a magnifying glass hung on his chest, long fingers stained with machine oil.
states.cane_sprain: The same Hanshuang: right ankle old injury, leaning on a cane made from a broken ruler, gray felt work clothes worn through at the knees, magnifying glass still hung on his chest.
states.silent_death: Hanshuang has closed his eyes and passed away, lying quietly on a folding cot in the clocktower machine room, gray felt work clothes covering his chest.

states.young_apprentice: A fifteen-year-old apprentice girl in deep-blue overalls, a small pocket-watch chain at her waist, keen eyes.
states.adult_technician: A woman technician in her early twenties, still with the pocket-watch chain and deep-blue overalls, upright build, able to calibrate the whole clockwork alone.

states.intact: A palm-sized astronomical escapement wheel, star-scale marks on the rim, gem bearings flashing, meshing smoothly with the pallet fork.
states.broken_teeth: The same astronomical escapement wheel missing two teeth, bearings blackened by machine oil, trembling lightly as it swings.
states.teeth_replaced: After new teeth are fitted, the astronomical escapement wheel runs smooth again; the new teeth are slightly lighter in color, star-scale marks still clear.

states.intact: A lacquered-cloth-cover timing log recording daily rate error, winding times, and tower-clock maintenance notes.
states.oil_stained: The same timing log soaked through with machine oil, cover sticky, error figures blurred into black blotches.

states.intact: A brass inspection cradle with a number carved on the guardrail, hoist rope clipped to the clocktower gallery rail, able to rise beside the clock face.
states.crashed: After falling from the rail, the brass inspection cradle has a twisted guardrail, cracked number plate, and hoist rope spilled in loose coils.

states.young_rival: A youth whose face closely resembles Doudou's, but wearing a silver-gray scarf and charcoal-black overalls, arrogant expression.
states.remade_face: After remaking his look, Aheng still wears the silver-gray scarf, a metal scrape mark on his brow ridge, charcoal-black overalls swapped for a leather-buckle cut.

E7.name: clocktower machine room
E7.appearance: The top-floor clocktower machine room: huge gear trains hum low, clock-hammer haul ropes hang by the wall, a timing bench and oil cups sit by the window.

E8.name: clocktower gallery
E8.appearance: A narrow gallery ringing the clock face, strong wind, city rooftops below, the huge white clock face right beside.

E9.name: gear passage
E9.appearance: The gear passage from the machine room to the clock face, lubricated tooth racks and drive shafts on both sides, lights flickering.

E10.name: stopped old clocktower
E10.appearance: The south-city stopped old clocktower, hands frozen at three, cracks crawling across the face, cobwebs draped over the gears.

E11.name: Han family nameplate
E11.appearance: A brass nameplate nailed to the machine-room door, engraved with 'Han Timing' and a year, edges polished bright.

E12.name: oil cups
E12.appearance: Three pointed-spout brass oil cups, each body engraved with a different gear number, set on the timing bench.

E13.name: iron scaffold lift
E13.appearance: A temporary iron scaffold lift with no brass guardrail number, able only to stop on the gallery floor.

E14.name: municipal clock officer
E14.appearance: A lean municipal clock officer also in a gray felt newsboy cap, but with a municipal gear badge on the shoulder, build close to Hanshuang's.

E15.name: inspection gas lamps
E15.appearance: Five brass inspection gas lamps hung in a row under the machine-room beams, glass shades reflecting gear shadows.

E16.name: tower clock bells
E16.appearance: Two tower clock bells suspended above the machine room, struck by hammer rods on the hour, bodies glowing dark gold.

E17.name: Lingling
E17.appearance: A news-selling girl on the clocktower square in light-brown overalls; at a glance like young Doudou, but wearing round glasses with shy unfamiliar eyes.

E18.name: spare escapement wheel
E18.appearance: A smaller spare escapement wheel of similar shape, but without star-scale marks, bearings only ordinary brass.

E19.name: wooden ladder cart
E19.appearance: A cart loaded with a folding wooden ladder and toolbox, no hoist rope or brass guardrail, definitely not an inspection cradle.

features.E6: Aheng: face nearly identical to Doudou's, but silver-gray scarf, charcoal-black overalls.

scenes.setting: Clocktower machine room at dusk (gas lamps and bronze bells)
actions: At dusk, Hanshuang pushes open the clocktower machine room iron door and sets the astronomical escapement wheel at the center of the timing bench.

actions.action: Five brass inspection gas lamps hang in a row under the machine-room beams; Hanshuang polishes each glass shade that reflects gear shadows.
Two tower clock bells hang above the machine room; Hanshuang gently nudges a hammer rod, letting the low chime roll among the gears.

actions: Hanshuang seats the astronomical escapement wheel into the pallet fork, watching whether the swing catches mid-tooth.
He drips a little watch oil onto a gear by the timing bench and listens as the whole train slowly meshes.
Hanshuang unties the wax cord and opens the lacquered-cloth-cover timing log.
He notes today's rate error, mainspring tension, and hourly strike deviation in carbon ink.
Hanshuang closes the log and returns the astronomical escapement wheel to the velvet pad so the teeth will not bend.
On the morning clocktower gallery, Hanshuang greets young Doudou pushing the brass inspection cradle in.

actions.action: Doudou buckles the cradle guardrail and hooks the hoist rope into the gallery rail safety catch.
Hanshuang sets three brass oil cups on the timing bench and teaches Doudou the matching gear numbers.
Doudou crouches by the brass inspection cradle and polishes the number plate on the guardrail with her sleeve.

actions: In the gear passage, Aheng in the silver-gray scarf turns his head from behind a drive-shaft shadow.
Aheng taps the brass buckle on his charcoal-black overalls with a knuckle, deliberately avoiding oil drips.
He lifts a coil of fine steel cable and walks off along the narrow path beside the tooth racks.
A small window in the passage flashes Aheng's profile, the silver-gray scarf lifted at one corner by the wind.
On the clocktower gallery, Doudou and Aheng brush past beside the clock face—one in deep-blue overalls, one in a silver-gray scarf.
Doudou shields the pocket-watch chain at her waist; Aheng hikes the charcoal-black overalls higher on his shoulder.
Both hear a trial strike of the tower clock, then walk opposite ways along the gallery.
Months later on a stormy night, Hanshuang keeps watch alone in the clocktower machine room, the astronomical escapement wheel resting on the velvet pad.

actions.action: He opens the timing log and finds machine oil leaked from the gear box; the lacquered-cloth cover is sticky, error figures blurred into black blotches.

actions: Hanshuang presses blotting paper to the stained page edges and rechecks the winding times still readable.
Through the long timing season, Hanshuang winds, listens to the beat, and calibrates the hour day after day in the machine room.
Another snowy night, he pulls the gray felt work clothes tight and keeps watch by the gear train for the city clock chime.
Spring mist fills the air; Hanshuang opens the gallery window to check that the clock hands are free of condensed water.
At high summer noon, he wipes copper filings squeezed from gear roots by heat expansion.
Autumn wind enters the machine room; the clock-hammer haul ropes gently bump the wall.
At dawn, Hanshuang patrols along the clocktower gallery; the brass inspection cradle rests to the right of the clock face.

actions.action: He bends to check the cradle guardrail and rail safety catch, confirming the hoist rope is not worn through.
Hanshuang gathers small gears scattered on the gallery into a toolbox so they will not roll into the drain channel.
A temporary iron scaffold lift is pushed in from the stair landing; the iron frame has no brass guardrail number and cannot hang beside the clock face.

actions: Rain lashes the huge clock face; the gallery rail screeches in the wind.

actions.action: Hanshuang has just reseated the astronomical escapement wheel in the movement when two teeth shear off under a misaligned shock.
The brass inspection cradle is shoved off the clock face by the gale; the hoist rope thrashes violently on the rail.
The hoist rope finally snaps; the brass inspection cradle plunges from the gallery, guardrail twisted, number plate cracked.
Hanshuang cradles the broken-toothed escapement wheel back into the machine room; rain drips from his cap brim onto the timing bench.
The day after the storm, Hanshuang stands in the machine room staring at the broken-toothed astronomical escapement wheel.
On a blank page of the timing log he notes the moment the brass inspection cradle crashed; black machine oil soaks to the edge of the words.
On a wall hook hangs the hoist rope torn from the brass inspection cradle; Hanshuang leaves it there a long while.
Hanshuang takes one of the five inspection gas lamps from under the beams to light the oil-blurred error table in the log.
He places the cracked number plate from the brass inspection cradle into a parts box and closes the velvet lid.

actions: Weeks later, Hanshuang brings in an old clockmaker to remove the two sheared teeth on the timing bench.

actions.action: The old clockmaker first holds up a spare escapement wheel for comparison; similar size, but without star-scale marks.
After new teeth are riveted into the rim, the astronomical escapement wheel again meshes smoothly with the pallet fork.

actions: Hanshuang oils the teeth-replaced escapement wheel lightly and watches the pendulum rod return to an even beat.

scenes.setting: False friends: wooden ladder cart and clock officer

actions.action: A wooden ladder cart is pushed onto the gallery; it holds only a folding wooden ladder and toolbox—not the crashed brass inspection cradle.
The municipal clock officer steps beside Hanshuang to inspect the clock face; both wear gray felt newsboy caps, backs nearly alike.
The clock officer points at the wooden ladder cart to schedule tomorrow's face washing; Hanshuang keeps listening to the tower clock's return swing.

scenes.setting: False friend: Lingling who resembles Doudou

actions.action: Square news girl Lingling climbs the gallery to deliver papers; her light-brown overalls from afar look like young Doudou's deep-blue ones.
Lingling tries to grip the safety rope; Hanshuang shakes his head, noting her round glasses—she is not Doudou after all.
Years later at dusk, Hanshuang leans on the broken-ruler cane and slowly enters the stopped old clocktower.
Above the old machine room, those two tower clock bells still hang, dust thick on the hammer rods.

actions: Hanshuang rests his cane under the cracked clock face and hears a very soft chime echo through the empty tower.

actions.action: By day, adult Doudou returns to the south city with a timing toolbox and hurries into the stopped old clocktower.

actions: Under the old machine-room door Doudou reunites with cane-leaning Hanshuang; they embrace through gear dust.

actions.action: Beside the folding cot, Doudou holds Hanshuang's oil-stained hand and listens to the last hourly chime outside the window.
Hanshuang's breath fades; he finally closes his eyes and quietly leaves the clocktower machine room.
Behind the machine-room door Hanshuang's gray felt work clothes still hang; Doudou strokes the cloth worn through at the knees.
Doudou stands before the Han family nameplate; the year Hanshuang himself engraved is lit by a gas lamp.
She cleans the nameplate Hanshuang left and screws it back onto the machine-room door.
Remade-face Aheng climbs the old clocktower spiral stair; the metal scrape on his brow ridge glints in the window light.

actions: Doudou and Aheng stand side by side before the cracked clock face—one pocket-watch chain soft-clicking, one silver-gray scarf hanging.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—that apprentice girl polishing the inspection-cradle number plate appears again.

anchor.phrase: the apprentice girl polishing the inspection-cradle number plate

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the machine room, a star-scale escapement wheel seats into the pallet fork for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the star-scale escapement wheel first seated into the pallet fork at the opening

actions.action: Flashback to the gear passage—that similar figure in a silver-gray scarf slips past a drive shaft.

anchor.phrase: the figure in a silver-gray scarf in the gear passage that year

actions.action: Again those five brass little lamps under the machine-room beams, reflecting gear shadows.

anchor.phrase: those five brass little lamps under the machine-room beams

actions.action: Back to that wind-swept gallery of first meeting; the white clock face and city rooftops are as they were.

anchor.phrase: that wind-swept gallery of first meeting

actions.action: Doudou opens that oil-stained timing log and writes her first independent timing entry on a new page.
The five inspection gas lamps under the beams still burn; gear shadows fall on her deep-blue overalls.
On the timing bench, those earlier three brass oil cups remain lined up by gear number.
Doudou reseats the teeth-replaced astronomical escapement wheel into the movement; the tower clock strikes on time.
